_comment: Project-owned assumptions for delivery reports. Every number here is an assumption, not a measurement. Edit them; reports print them next to the results.

human.note: Senior developer, includes tests and documentation. Replace with your own rate.

tokens.note: Tokens are ESTIMATED from Kiro session logs (characters / chars_per_token * tokenizer_factor). Models from Claude 4.7 on produce about 30% more tokens for the same text. Context is capped because the harness compacts long sessions.

caching.note: With caching, each call re-reads the previous context at the cache-read rate and writes only the new part. Without it, the whole context is billed as input on every call (upper bound).

comparison.note: Time for the comparison model = measured agent time x agent_time_factor. This is an ASSUMPTION (fewer rejections and retries, similar speed per call). Calibrate it after a phase has been run with both models.

credits.note: Kiro credits are recorded as measured. Set usd_per_credit from your Kiro plan to show a dollar figure.

delivery.note: Set to a phase number (for example 2) to make doctor warn when a task in that phase or later lacks Risk, Human estimate or Time budget.
